Elliot (eng-oncall): quick follow-up from the kv eviction postmortem. we need a compact, trackable plan for tests + owners. can we lock this down now?
Rae (eng-ml): proposed package: (1) 60-prompt regression pack focused on prefix reuse, (2) pre-merge golden pair, (3) nightly prefix-sweep load that ramps seq len.
Jon (eng-sre): i'll take alert tuning and the chaos microdrill runbook. scope: 20m eviction pressure + pod restart, with clear rollback conditions.
Marta (eng-platform): i'll own CI plumbing: `pre-merge/kv-goldens` and `nightly/kv-prefix-sweep`. will push eval metrics to the dashboard.
Elliot (eng-oncall): deadlines: goldens + small PR in 7 days, nightly job + dashboard in 12 days, chaos dry-run in 14 days. ok?
Rae (eng-ml): ok I'll curate the 60 prompts from incident repros and tag two as `@golden-pair`. initial pack in 6 days.
Jon (eng-sre): i'll draft the runbook and add heatmap logging. dry-run ETA 13 days.
Marta (eng-platform): sample CI snippet for pre-merge: `pytest tests/regressions/test_goldens.py -k golden` (goal <30s). will open branch `ci/kv-guardians`.
Elliot (eng-oncall): ops-bot: please create epic and subtasks with owners/due dates. add postmortem link.
ops-bot: Created epic EPI-2799 "kv-guardians-regression-pack". Subtasks: EPI-2799-1 prompt-pack (Rae) due 1790590000, EPI-2799-2 ci-jobs+dashboards (Marta) due 1790670000, EPI-2799-3 chaos-dry-run (Jon) due 1790690000.
Rae (eng-ml): request: platform, expose prefix-length buckets in metrics so we can slice scorer results.
Marta (eng-platform): will add histogram export for prefix buckets; linking infra ticket shortly.
Elliot (eng-oncall): summary: owners assigned, epic created, canary in staging targeted within 2 weeks, reconvene in 7 days for status. :thumbsup:
Rae (eng-ml): ack, starting curation.
Jon (eng-sre): ack, drafting runbook.
Marta (eng-platform): ack, creating CI branch now.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: status check in 7 days (1790000000).
